reason: This rule suggests that if a city is forcibly exiled and the reason for the Babylonian Captivity is also that the city was forcibly exiled, then it concludes that the city never happened in the context of the Babylonian Captivity. This creates a contradiction because the premise asserts the city's existence through exile, while the conclusion denies its existence.
reflecting_rules: - 2. Q[city, Babylonian_Captivity](people_of_once_glorious_city(status, forcibly_exiled) ∧ Babylonian_Captivity(exile_reason, forcibly_exiled) → city(never_happened, Babylonian_Captivity))
